name: Meeting Room (3 speakers)
description: Three characters in a meeting room — one presenter, two participants

environment.summary: a modern meeting room with a glass conference table, whiteboard, and large windows overlooking a city
environment.lighting: even overhead light with cooler natural daylight from the windows

style: professional and clean, shallow depth of field on close-ups

shots.camera: Wide establishing shot — all three subjects visible around the table
shots.action: {A} stands at the head of the table. {B} and {C} are seated across from each other.

shots.camera: Medium shot of {A} at the whiteboard
shots.action: {A} gestures toward the whiteboard and begins presenting their point.
{B} nods and makes notes. {C} listens attentively, arms crossed.
{B} raises a point in response to {A}'s presentation.
{C} adds their perspective, addressing both {A} and {B}.

overall_soundscape: Quiet office ambience with distant keyboard clicks and HVAC hum.
